7-Day Classic Jordan Tour: Petra, Wadi Rum & Dead Sea
summary:
The 7-Day Jordan Tour gives northern Jordan more attention than most compact routes before heading south to Petra and Wadi Rum. From Amman, travel to Umm Qais, the Roman ruins of Jerash and Ajloun Castle, then turn east for the Desert Castles. Madaba and Mount Nebo bring biblical history into the journey before the final stages at Petra and among the desert landscapes of Wadi Rum.
All road travel is handled privately, allowing these widely separated sites to fit naturally into seven days. The year-round package provides selected 4-star hotels with breakfast, English-speaking local guides, transfers, entrance fees and scheduled sightseeing.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Amman
itinerary.text:
Arrival at Queen Alia International Airport. Meet and transfer to your hotel in Amman.
Hotel check-in after 14:00. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Amman.

itinerary.title: Visit Umm Qais, Jerash and Ajloun
itinerary.text: Visit Umm Qais and enjoy panoramic views over the Jordan Valley and the Sea of Galilee. Continue to Jerash and explore its impressive Roman ruins, including the Oval Plaza and the Temple of Artemis. Then visit Ajloun Castle, the famous 12th-century Islamic fortress. Discover Jordan’s rich Roman and Islamic history before returning to Amman for overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Visit Desert Castles of Jordan
itinerary.text: Visit the Desert Castles in eastern Jordan. Explore Qusayr Amra, a UNESCO World Heritage Site famous for its early Islamic frescoes and zodiac dome. Continue to Qasr Kharana and the historic fortress of Qasr Al-Azraq. Discover Jordan’s rich early Islamic and Roman history before returning to Amman. Overnight in Amman.

itinerary.title: Visit the King's Highway, Madaba, Mount Nebo, and Kerak Castle.
itinerary.text: Visit Mount Nebo, where Prophet Moses viewed the Promised Land. Enjoy panoramic views over the Jordan Valley, the Dead Sea, Jericho, and Jerusalem. Continue to Madaba and see the famous mosaic map at the Saint George Church. Drive along the historic King's Highway and stop at Wadi Mujib for scenic views. Explore the impressive Kerak Castle before continuing to Petra. Overnight in Petra.

itinerary.title: Visiting Petra
itinerary.text: Explore Petra, Jordan’s famous red-rose city and ancient Nabataean capital. Walk through the Siq to reach the impressive Al-Khazneh (Treasury). Optional horse ride available at the entrance of Petra. Enjoy free time to explore Petra’s temples, tombs, and ancient ruins at your own pace. Overnight in Petra.

itinerary.title: Petra to Wadi Rum and back to Amman
itinerary.text: Drive to Wadi Rum, one of the world’s most spectacular desert landscapes. Enjoy a 4x4 jeep safari through canyons, sand dunes, and ancient Nabataean rock inscriptions. Experience the traditional Bedouin lifestyle in the desert before returning to Amman. Overnight in Amman.

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the 7-Day Jordan Tour Package?
faqs.a: The 7-Day Jordan Tour Package covers Amman, Jerash, Petra, Wadi Rum, and the Dead Sea. This private itinerary combines Jordan's vibrant capital, ancient Roman ruins, breathtaking desert landscapes, the world-famous city of Petra, and the relaxing shores of the Dead Sea. The tour runs for 6 nights and 7 days.

faqs.q: How much does the 7-Day Jordan Tour Package cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from €1,275 per person for the 2026 season. The price includes accommodation, private land transportation, an English-speaking driver, entrance fees according to the itinerary, selected meals, and airport and hotel transfers. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates and hotel category.

faqs.q: Is transportation included throughout the tour?
faqs.a: Yes, private land transportation is included throughout the entire journey. You will travel in a comfortable private vehicle with an English-speaking driver, providing flexibility and convenience while exploring Jordan.

faqs.q: What kind of accommodation does the tour provide?
faqs.a: The package includes accommodation in carefully selected hotels with daily breakfast. Hotels are chosen for their comfort, service quality, and convenient locations near the major attractions visited during the tour.

faqs.q: Is a guide included in the tour?
faqs.a: This package includes an English-speaking driver rather than a full-time tour guide. Local guides can be arranged at major attractions such as Petra upon request. Your driver will assist with transportation, logistics, and general travel information throughout the trip.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to Jordan?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is ideal for first-time visitors who want to experience Jordan's most famous attractions while enjoying the comfort and flexibility of a private itinerary. It offers an excellent introduction to the country's history, culture, and natural beauty.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is moderate. Travelers should be comfortable walking through archaeological sites, desert landscapes, and historic towns. Petra involves several kilometers of walking, while Wadi Rum includes outdoor desert activities.

faqs.q: What are the highlights of Petra, Wadi Rum, Jerash, and the Dead Sea?
faqs.a: Petra is Jordan's most iconic UNESCO World Heritage Site, famous for the Treasury and remarkable rock-cut architecture. Wadi Rum offers spectacular desert scenery and unforgettable jeep safari experiences. Jerash is one of the best-preserved Roman cities in the world, while the Dead Sea provides the unique opportunity to float effortlessly in its mineral-rich waters.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the 7-Day Jordan Tour Package?
faqs.a: You can generally cancel free of charge up to 30 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within the applicable cancellation period may be subject to fees according to the booking terms and cancellation policy. Travel insurance is recommended for additional flexibility and protection.

faqs.q: Can the 7-Day Jordan Tour Package be customized?
faqs.a: Yes, the tour can be fully customized according to your preferences. You can add extra nights, upgrade hotel categories, include local guides, add destinations such as Aqaba or Mount Nebo, or modify the itinerary to match your interests. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
